_comment: Cards that exist only for the stolen-blocker-declaration test (tests/unit/combat/test_choose_blockers.py). Never part of a deck list; loaded by the test registry fixture alongside data/cards/. `t_tactician` is Odric, Master Tactician's printed line -- the battalion trigger written the way the shipped pool writes it (Frontline Medic: `attacks` with `source: "self"` and a count over an `attacking` selector) plus the op that takes the declaration over. A bare `you_attack` is NOT the same card: it carries no requirement that the source be among the attackers, so Odric would fire while sitting at home behind four others. `t_tactician_now` drops the three-other-creatures condition so the takeover can be measured with a small attack. The menace creature used to show the defender's own requirements still binding the thief is the shared `t_menacer` in testing.cards.json.
